title: ERC-735 Claim Holder proposed as a GitHub issue
detail: Fabian Vogelsteller opens ethereum/EIPs issues for ERC-734 Key Manager and ERC-735 Claim Holder, the basis of ONCHAINID. Neither became an EIP file.

title: Lightning Labs starts the LSAT specification
detail: First commit of the LSAT (Lightning Service Authentication Token) repository: macaroon plus Lightning invoice behind HTTP 402.

title: ERC-3643 (T-REX) created
detail: Permissioned token standard with ONCHAINID claims; now Final.

title: LSAT renamed L402 in the Lightning Labs specification
detail: Documentation rewrite replaces LSAT with L402; both scheme names remain accepted.

title: bLIP-0026 L402 drafted
detail: Lightning Labs authors propose L402 to the Lightning bLIP process (PR #26, still open on 2026-10-11).

title: NPCI, Razorpay and OpenAI announce UPI agentic payments pilot
detail: ChatGPT purchases over UPI using Reserve Pay and UPI Circle; pilot with Axis Bank and Airtel Payments Bank.

title: Amazon sues Perplexity over the Comet shopping agent
detail: CFAA and California CDAFA claims plus a preliminary injunction motion, N.D. Cal. No. 3:25-cv-09514.

title: NPCI and Razorpay extend UPI agentic payments pilot to Claude
detail: Announced at the India AI Impact Summit with Zomato, Swiggy and Zepto; small user group.

title: bLIP-0026 rewritten to be token-agnostic
detail: Draft adds version="0" and a generic token= parameter; macaroons become RECOMMENDED, not required. Lightning Labs' own repository text still uses macaroon=.

title: A402 paper proposes atomic payment and service
detail: arXiv:2603.01179 argues x402 lacks atomicity across execution, payment and delivery; academic proposal only.

title: Court enjoins Perplexity's Comet agent from Amazon accounts
detail: Preliminary injunction with a seven-day administrative stay; the Ninth Circuit later stayed it pending appeal.

title: Tempo mainnet and MPP released
detail: Tempo launches mainnet and introduces the Machine Payments Protocol, co-authored with Stripe.

title: ERC-8226 Regulated Agent Mandate proposed
detail: Draft ERC from Brickken authors: scoped, time-bounded, capped agent authority over regulated tokens, naming ERC-3643 or ERC-7943 and ERC-8004 as adjacent layers.

title: American Express announces Agent Purchase Protection
detail: Issuer commitment to protect eligible Card Members from charges caused by registered AI agent errors, terms apply.

title: Ninth Circuit vacates the Amazon v. Perplexity injunction
detail: The user, not Perplexity, accessed Amazon using the agent as a tool; Amazon unlikely to succeed under the CFAA or CDAFA on these facts. Remanded.

title: NPCI AI-agent registry for UPI reported
detail: Reuters-relayed report of a planned agent registry and framework; no NPCI publication found.

title: Web Monetization draft republished
detail: WICG Draft Community Group Report with Interledger Foundation editors; not a W3C standard. No agent program announced.

title: ERC-8226 adds per-asset mandates
detail: Mandates keyed by agent, principal and asset (PR #2060). Still Draft.
